title: CORRECTION of 20261121-002 (casualty figure superseded): the Nov 21 Bahrain strike injured two, one critically, not 'no injuries'; plus Nov 22: Houthis claim a direct hit on Saudi Rabigh refinery (unconfirmed), UKMTO reports a tanker and 'military forces' incident off Chabahar (a US strike is unconfirmed), Trump inclined to strike after New Year
body:
# Iran and Gulf, Nov 21 to 23

**Guard:** IRAN_WAR_GUARDS.md read whole 2026-11-23 before this dispatch; anchor full sweep 2026-11-18 (next about 11/25). anchor_unverified_as_of: 2026-11-18. Events since are FALCON's to grade; no war-state framing is asserted.

| # | Item | Basis | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Bahrain 11/21: two injured**, a Bahraini citizen (stable) and a Pakistani resident (critical). Interior Ministry statement 11/22 about the 11/21 attack. Site still NOT named; residents saw smoke over Sitra | Arab News/AFP page read | Supersedes 'no injuries' on 20261121-002. SAME event: the page establishes no separate 11/22 strike on Bahrain |
| 2 | **Rabigh refinery (Saudi Red Sea coast), Houthi claim 11/22:** 'direct hit'. 'Saudi authorities have not confirmed any attacks on refineries.' Coalition (al-Malki): one ballistic missile toward the western Red Sea coast intercepted, not linked to Rabigh; accounts differ on missile or two drones and on timing. Fire videos not verified | New Arab page read; rest search summary | CLAIM ONLY. Carry claimed / intercepted / damaged separately. Earlier Rabigh claims: card 20261007-015 and, per search, 10/25 |
| 3 | **UKMTO, Sunday evening 11/22:** a tanker in an incident with 'military forces', Gulf of Oman near Chabahar. One analyst says the US struck it | search summary; ukmto.org not read | US strike UNCONFIRMED. No vessel name. Gulf of Oman, not the Strait |
| 4 | **Two tankers off Khasab 11/21**, named TORKEL and ARINA in one daily update | search summary | FALCON already holds Khasab hulls 11/20 to 11/21 with TORKEL (KB-534). Do not count again; ARINA and dates are FALCON's |
| 5 | **Trump, Fox News 11/22:** inclined to resume strikes after the New Year without a deal; convoy runners 'will all be at the bottom of the sea' | search summary | POTUS-channel remark, tape not information; no order |
| 6 | Iran: 'every means' / 'all available means' against the blockade (Euronews, Al Jazeera 11/23) | titles | Declaratory |
| 7 | Kharg: 16 tankers at anchor had not moved, no group under way | search summary | Fits FALCON KB-536 (staged, not sailed) |
| 8 | 'IRGC downs another US MQ-1 drone' (Tasnim 11/22); 'Iran says it attacked 2 US bases' (NewsNation) | titles | CLAIM ONLY; the second matches the 11/21 Riffa and Awali claim |
| 9 | 'Bahrain's Bapco refinery to reach full capacity by year-end after attacks, CEO says' (Reuters 11/18) | title | Refinery was already below full capacity before 11/21 |

**Brent:** named BZF27 89.93 (vendor intraday 11/23) vs 92.57 [11/20 vendor bar]. BRENT owns it.
